title: Iteration State
definition: Iteration state is the information inspected or changed between repetitions to determine progress and results.
purpose: Make each loop step traceable and connect updates to continuation and output.
history: State tables and traces are long-standing tools for explaining and verifying iterative programs.
mental_model: Take a snapshot before and after each round; the differences explain both progress and accumulated work.
analogy: A scoreboard changes after each play; it fails because program state may include several dependent values and hidden effects.
common_mistakes: Changing state outside the intended step
industry_notes: Explicit state and deterministic updates improve observability, testing, and incident diagnosis.
ai_notes: Require state snapshots rather than accepting an AI summary that skips intermediate values.
interview_notes: Ask the candidate to trace every iteration without executing the code.
lab_candidates: Compare expected and actual state transitions
